node.title: Rank-eleven rich-container incidence collision compiler
node.closure: exact double/triple incidence moments for the 508 promoted rich containers
node.statement: Among any 508 promoted dimension-two/three rich containers with at least 42453 actual zero coordinates each inside an anchor-good set of size at most 1116048, one coordinate belongs to at least 20 containers, one pair spans dimension at most 6 and has at least 1536 common zeros, and one triple spans dimension at most 9 and has at least 53 common zeros. A same-dimension subfamily of 254 containers has corresponding thresholds 10, 1458, and 45 with pair/triple span dimensions at most 2r and 3r. No locator synchronization or cross-bucket owner is claimed.
